fact: The anticipatory-action drought pilot for Chad (final version of 24 October 2022), whose trigger model was developed with FAO and the DREM of the Ministry of Environment and Water, sets a third trigger window on biomass observation data (80% anomaly) published in September.
title: Cadre de l'action anticipatoire - Pilote au Tchad : Sècheresse (version finale du 24 octobre 2022)
